extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Luminous and non-luminous objects — Luminous: produce their own light. Sun, stars, candle flame, light bulb (on), firefly. Non-luminous: do not produce light, only reflect light from luminous objects. Moon, book, chair, mirror, planets. We see non-luminous objects because light from a luminous source bounces off them and reaches our eyes. (2) Transparent, translucent, opaque — Transparent: light passes through completely, you can see clearly. Clear glass, water, clear plastic. Translucent: light passes through partially, you see a blurred image. Frosted glass, wax paper, tissue paper, butter paper. Opaque: no light passes through, you cannot see through. Wood, stone, metal, cardboard. (3) Shadow formation — Three conditions: a light source, an opaque object, and a surface (screen/ground). Shadow forms on the opposite side of the light source. Shadow size changes with distance: closer to light = bigger shadow, farther from light = smaller shadow. Transparent objects do not cast shadows. Opaque objects cast dark shadows. (4) Day and night — Earth rotates on its axis (an imaginary line from North Pole to South Pole). One rotation takes 24 hours. The side facing the sun has day, the side away from the sun has night. As Earth rotates, different parts face the sun, causing day and night. (5) Solar and lunar eclipses — Solar eclipse: Moon comes between Sun and Earth, Moon's shadow falls on Earth, Sun appears blocked. Occurs during the day. Lunar eclipse: Earth comes between Sun and Moon, Earth's shadow falls on Moon, Moon appears dark. Occurs at night. Misconceptions: 'the moon produces its own light' (WRONG — the moon is non-luminous; it reflects sunlight), 'transparent and translucent are the same' (WRONG — transparent allows full light through and clear vision; translucent allows partial light and blurred vision), 'shadows form without a screen' (WRONG — a shadow needs a surface to fall on; without a screen or ground, the shadow has nothing to be seen on), 'day and night are caused by the sun moving' (WRONG — day and night are caused by Earth rotating on its axis; the sun does not move around Earth), 'solar eclipse and lunar eclipse are the same' (WRONG — solar eclipse: moon blocks sun; lunar eclipse: earth blocks sun from reaching moon).
